description: This Java source file defines the EventCheckHelper class, which provides various methods to verify and assert that specific events have been correctly triggered in the context of testing the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for checking client events, loan lifecycle events, transaction events, asset transfers, and delinquency-related events, primarily by interacting with the API, retrieving data, and asserting expected event data matches actual data.

classes.name: EventCheckHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to verify the correctness of various events related to clients, loans, transactions, and asset transfers in the Fineract testing framework.

methods.name: clientEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies that a client creation event is correctly triggered and the retrieved client data matches expectations.

methods.name: createLoanEventCheck
methods.description: Checks that a loan creation event has been fired and the loan data matches the expected values.

methods.name: approveLoanEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies the event triggered upon loan approval, comparing retrieved loan details with the event data.

methods.name: undoApproveLoanEventCheck
methods.description: Checks that an undo approval event was raised for a loan.

methods.name: loanRejectedEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies that a loan rejection event was triggered for a specific loan.

methods.name: disburseLoanEventCheck
methods.description: Checks that a loan disbursal event has been triggered for the given loan ID.

methods.name: loanBalanceChangedEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies that a loan balance changed event is triggered and matches current loan state.

methods.name: loanStatusChangedEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies that a loan status change event has been correctly raised.

methods.name: loanAccountDataV1Check
methods.description: Private helper method to verify detailed loan account data against retrieved data from the API.

methods.name: getNthTransactionType
methods.description: Fetches the nth transaction of a specific type and date from a list of loan transactions.

methods.name: findNthTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the specified transaction that matches type and date from the loan API data.

methods.name: checkTransactionWithLoanTransactionAdjustmentBizEvent
methods.description: Validates that a loan transaction adjustment business event has been correctly triggered.

methods.name: loanUndoContractTerminationEventCheck
methods.description: Checks that a loan undo contract termination business event was raised for the specified transaction.

methods.name: areBigDecimalValuesEqual
methods.description: Utility method to compare BigDecimal values for equality with debugging logs.

methods.name: loanDisbursalTransactionEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies that a loan disbursal transaction event was triggered with correct details.

methods.name: transactionEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies the event triggered for a specific loan transaction based on type.

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventCheck
methods.description: Checks that an asset ownership transfer event has been correctly generated with proper details.

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventWithStatusCheck
methods.description: Validates ownership transfer event including status and reason details.

methods.name: loanOwnershipTransferBusinessEventWithTypeCheck
methods.description: Verifies ownership transfer event including specific transfer type and previous owner info.

methods.name: loanAccountSnapshotBusinessEventCheck
methods.description: Checks snapshot of the loan account, including total outstanding and interest, considering external asset transfer behavior.

methods.name: loanAccountDelinquencyPauseChangedBusinessEventCheck
methods.description: Verifies that a delinquency pause change event occurred with correct pause periods.

methods.name: installmentLevelDelinquencyRangeChangeEventCheck
methods.description: Validates that installment delinquency buckets sum correctly and match expected event data.

methods.name: zeroConversion
methods.description: Utility method to convert BigDecimal 0.000000 to scale 8 for comparison.
